A.why: Strong dead-labourer funerary read (banded wraps, crossed straps, slate eye-band mask) but from above it is pale banded wrap: reads as linen.
A.fix: Cool the pale to stone grey, fewer thicker slate bands, and spend parts on a real yoke across the shoulders or a slung pick.

B.why: Brimmed overseer hat is a real silhouette, but the set is even mid-grey near iron and nothing is funerary.
B.fix: Push tunic to dust-white with one slate accent; add a dust veil from the brim or a grave tag; wider flatter brim.

C.why: Brimmed helm with pick handle and pale pick tabard reads as a quarry guard, but charcoal sleeves and back pull it toward iron and there is no burial cue.
C.fix: Pale the arms, keep slate to one band; make the pick on the helm a real pick head; add a grave-wrap or niche-arched tabard.

D.why: Charcoal-slate plate with pale trim reads as the iron set; no quarry or funeral story; cleanest fit.
D.fix: Invert the palette to dust-white body with slate as one accent, and pick one silhouette idea (stone helm, yoke, slung pick).

E.why: Palette closest to brief (dust-white, one slate on shoulder slabs, rust), mallet hung at belt, niche hood is on theme; hood is an oversized box and thin stripes add noise.
E.fix: Bring the hood in and shape an arched niche opening; merge thin stripes into broad bands; second hung tool; lose the stray back square.

F.why: Carved stone-block mask echoes the colossus and reads at pitch 50; rust mantle vs pale pauldron is a clean asymmetric silhouette; on palette; but carries no tools.
F.fix: Hang a mallet/chisel or sling a pick; make the black arms cold slate; cool the warm pale away from linen oatmeal; deepen the mask carving.

notes: F and E are the two to carry forward: F has the best single silhouette idea (the stone colossus-face mask) and E the best palette and tool-hung read; a merge of F's mask with E's slate slabs and hung mallet would be the ideal. Common faults: dark charcoal masses drifting toward iron (C, D, F's arms), warm banded pale drifting toward linen (A), and many thin stripes that turn to noise from the high camera. Judged from renders only.
